THE FACTOR ZOO

slides.text:
SECTION 1–2
WHAT IS A FACTOR? 什么是因子？
A factor in equity research is a systematic, cross-sectionally observable characteristic — or return series constructed from such a characteristic — that explains differences in expected returns across stocks. If we write the return-generating process as:
then    is a factor return,    is the stock's loading, and    is idiosyncratic noise. A factor is useful if it reduces the covariance matrix to a low-rank-plus-diagonal structure and/or commands a non-zero risk premium       .
Critical epistemic point: "Anomaly" is model-relative, not absolute. As benchmark models expand (CAPM → FF3 → Carhart4 → FF5 → FF6), yesterday's anomaly becomes today's risk factor.
CHARACTERISTIC 特征
A firm-level observable at time   — e.g. book-to-market ratio     
FACTOR 因子
A return series (usually long-short) built by sorting stocks on a characteristic — e.g. HML
ANOMALY 异象
An empirical pattern a benchmark model fails to explain — model-relative, not absolute
ALPHA Α 阿尔法
The intercept in a factor-model regression: return unexplained by the chosen factors
Risk factors earn premia as compensation for bad-state exposure; mispricing factors capture the slow correction of behavioral or friction-driven price deviations — most documented factors are argued to be some mixture of both.

objects.name: Text 7
objects.text: Sharpe, Lintner, Mossin. One factor: market beta. The Security Market Line predicts every asset lies on             . Empirically rejected: flat SML, size effect, value effect, Roll's critique.

objects.name: Text 11
objects.text: Drops mean-variance machinery; assumes linear factor structure plus no-arbitrage. Justifies "find   common factors" empirically without requiring utility maximization. Expected returns are approximately linear in factor loadings:           .

objects.name: Text 15
objects.text: MKT + SMB (size) + HML (value). 2×3 independent sort: NYSE median size breakpoint; 30th/70th B/M breakpoints. Dramatically improved cross-section fit but could not explain momentum.

objects.name: Text 19
objects.text: FF3 + UMD (12-1 momentum, skipping last month). Rebalanced monthly — reflecting momentum's short signal half-life. Became the standard academic benchmark for a decade.

objects.name: Text 23
objects.text: FF5 adds RMW (profitability) + CMA (investment), motivated by dividend-discount-model decomposition — HML becomes largely redundant. q-factor derives same premia from production-side q-theory: ME, I/A, ROE. Two independent routes converging validates the profitability/investment premium.

slides.text:
SECTION 2
THEORETICAL LINEAGE 理论谱系
CAPM (1964–66)
Sharpe, Lintner, Mossin. One factor: market beta. The Security Market Line predicts every asset lies on             . Empirically rejected: flat SML, size effect, value effect, Roll's critique.
APT (ROSS 1976)
Drops mean-variance machinery; assumes linear factor structure plus no-arbitrage. Justifies "find   common factors" empirically without requiring utility maximization. Expected returns are approximately linear in factor loadings:           .
FF3 (1993)
MKT + SMB (size) + HML (value). 2×3 independent sort: NYSE median size breakpoint; 30th/70th B/M breakpoints. Dramatically improved cross-section fit but could not explain momentum.
CARHART 4 (1997)
FF3 + UMD (12-1 momentum, skipping last month). Rebalanced monthly — reflecting momentum's short signal half-life. Became the standard academic benchmark for a decade.
FF5 (2015) & Q-FACTOR (HXZ 2015)
FF5 adds RMW (profitability) + CMA (investment), motivated by dividend-discount-model decomposition — HML becomes largely redundant. q-factor derives same premia from production-side q-theory: ME, I/A, ROE. Two independent routes converging validates the profitability/investment premium.

objects.name: Text 2
objects.text: GRS TEST & WHY FACTORS EARN PREMIA 检验与溢价来源

objects.name: Text 6
objects.text: Time-series regressions test whether a portfolio's alpha is zero given factors:              . The GRS test asks whether all test-asset alphas are jointly zero — preventing one pretty alpha from hiding broad model failure. Sensitive to test-asset choice; one diagnostic, not a final verdict. 防止单一漂亮阿尔法掩盖模型普遍失败。

objects.name: Text 10
objects.text: Exposure to factor   raises the volatility of consumption/wealth in bad states (recessions, liquidity crunches, tail events). The premium     is demanded by rational, risk-averse investors — permanent because bearing the risk is unavoidable in equilibrium.

objects.name: Text 13
objects.text: BEHAVIORAL MISPRICING 行为错误定价

objects.name: Text 14
objects.text: Prices deviate from fundamental value due to investor psychology (overreaction, underreaction, extrapolation, lottery preference) or market frictions (limits to arbitrage, shorting costs, funding constraints). Premia can erode as more capital chases them or as trading costs rise. 原则上可被套利消除。

objects.name: Text 15
objects.text: No serious practitioner needs a factor to belong purely to one camp. What matters: does the story predict when the factor should fail? Value fails when distress risk is realized; momentum crashes at sharp rebounds; low volatility suffers when leverage constraints relax.

slides.text:
SECTION 3–4
GRS TEST & WHY FACTORS EARN PREMIA 检验与溢价来源
1
TIME-SERIES VS. CROSS-SECTIONAL TESTS
Time-series regressions test whether a portfolio's alpha is zero given factors:              . The GRS test asks whether all test-asset alphas are jointly zero — preventing one pretty alpha from hiding broad model failure. Sensitive to test-asset choice; one diagnostic, not a final verdict. 防止单一漂亮阿尔法掩盖模型普遍失败。
2
RISK COMPENSATION 风险补偿
Exposure to factor   raises the volatility of consumption/wealth in bad states (recessions, liquidity crunches, tail events). The premium     is demanded by rational, risk-averse investors — permanent because bearing the risk is unavoidable in equilibrium.
3
BEHAVIORAL MISPRICING 行为错误定价
Prices deviate from fundamental value due to investor psychology (overreaction, underreaction, extrapolation, lottery preference) or market frictions (limits to arbitrage, shorting costs, funding constraints). Premia can erode as more capital chases them or as trading costs rise. 原则上可被套利消除。
No serious practitioner needs a factor to belong purely to one camp. What matters: does the story predict when the factor should fail? Value fails when distress risk is realized; momentum crashes at sharp rebounds; low volatility suffers when leverage constraints relax.

objects.name: Text 2
objects.text: THE FACTOR ZOO PROBLEM 因子动物园问题

objects.name: Text 3
objects.text: Scale of the Problem 问题规模

objects.name: Text 5
objects.text: Hundreds of published anomalies cannot all be independent sources of expected return. Some are aliases for the same latent exposure, some are subsumed by known factors, some are too expensive to trade, and some are false discoveries produced by multiple testing on the same finite dataset. 数百个已发表异象不可能都是独立预期收益来源。

objects.name: Text 6
objects.text: The number of factors that "survive against an expanding set of controls" is far smaller than the number "in the literature." A t-stat of 2.0 that was once the publication threshold implies a false-discovery rate of roughly 50% under realistic multiple-testing conditions.

objects.name: Text 8
objects.text: Many claimed factors are linear combinations of MKT, SMB, HML, UMD — correlated aliases that add no independent pricing information.

objects.name: Text 10
objects.text: Thousands of characteristics tried on the same US equity sample. Even random characteristics pass a t>2 filter with high frequency given enough tries.

objects.name: Text 11
objects.text: MULTIPLE-TESTING DISCIPLINE 多重检验纪律

objects.name: Text 12
objects.text: Harvey, Liu & Zhu (2016): adjust thresholds upward (t > 3.0 for new factors). Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control. Out-of-sample and international replication are the gold standards.

objects.name: Text 14
objects.text: Economic rationale · point-in-time construction · robustness across periods and universes · low correlation to existing factors · implementable net of costs · multiple-testing-aware validation.

slides.text:
SECTION 5
THE FACTOR ZOO PROBLEM 因子动物园问题
Scale of the Problem 问题规模
400+
Hundreds of published anomalies cannot all be independent sources of expected return. Some are aliases for the same latent exposure, some are subsumed by known factors, some are too expensive to trade, and some are false discoveries produced by multiple testing on the same finite dataset. 数百个已发表异象不可能都是独立预期收益来源。
The number of factors that "survive against an expanding set of controls" is far smaller than the number "in the literature." A t-stat of 2.0 that was once the publication threshold implies a false-discovery rate of roughly 50% under realistic multiple-testing conditions.
REDUNDANCY 冗余
Many claimed factors are linear combinations of MKT, SMB, HML, UMD — correlated aliases that add no independent pricing information.
DATA MINING 数据挖掘
Thousands of characteristics tried on the same US equity sample. Even random characteristics pass a t>2 filter with high frequency given enough tries.
MULTIPLE-TESTING DISCIPLINE 多重检验纪律
Harvey, Liu & Zhu (2016): adjust thresholds upward (t > 3.0 for new factors). Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control. Out-of-sample and international replication are the gold standards.
MINIMUM STANDARD 最低标准
Economic rationale · point-in-time construction · robustness across periods and universes · low correlation to existing factors · implementable net of costs · multiple-testing-aware validation.

objects.name: Text 2
objects.text: CONSTRUCTION STYLES & FACTOR TIMING 构建方式与因子择时

objects.name: Text 5
objects.text: Decile or 2×3 sort; value-weighted; tests whether the premium exists in principle. Reports pure factor return. Not directly investable due to shorting costs, turnover, and capacity.

objects.name: Text 8
objects.text: Weights proportional to cross-sectional rank; dollar-neutral by construction; smoother exposure than decile sorts; still requires shorting but reduces turnover concentration.

objects.name: Text 11
objects.text: Factor expressed as overweights/underweights vs. a benchmark. Tests benchmark-relative stock selection under real constraints. Always report: weighting, rebalancing frequency, breakpoint universe, sector/beta neutrality.

objects.name: Text 13
objects.text: FACTOR TIMING & CROWDING 择时与拥挤

objects.name: Text 14
objects.text: Valuation spreads, macro regimes, crowding indicators can contain information — but add another layer of multiple testing. Safer default: diversification across factors with drawdown-aware risk budgeting. Monitor common-manager holdings, ETF flows, short interest, borrow cost, turnover spikes.

slides.text:
SECTIONS 8–9
CONSTRUCTION STYLES & FACTOR TIMING 构建方式与因子择时
LONG-SHORT ACADEMIC FACTOR
Decile or 2×3 sort; value-weighted; tests whether the premium exists in principle. Reports pure factor return. Not directly investable due to shorting costs, turnover, and capacity.
RANK-WEIGHTED DOLLAR-NEUTRAL
Weights proportional to cross-sectional rank; dollar-neutral by construction; smoother exposure than decile sorts; still requires shorting but reduces turnover concentration.
LONG-ONLY BENCHMARK TILT
Factor expressed as overweights/underweights vs. a benchmark. Tests benchmark-relative stock selection under real constraints. Always report: weighting, rebalancing frequency, breakpoint universe, sector/beta neutrality.
FACTOR TIMING & CROWDING 择时与拥挤
Valuation spreads, macro regimes, crowding indicators can contain information — but add another layer of multiple testing. Safer default: diversification across factors with drawdown-aware risk budgeting. Monitor common-manager holdings, ETF flows, short interest, borrow cost, turnover spikes.
